newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish November reserves fall to 85.0 bln Dkk.
newsitem.headline: Danish November reserves fall to 85.0 bln Dkk.

text.p: Denmark's foreign exchange reserves fell to 85.0 billion crowns at end-November 1996 from 88.7 billion crowns at end-October 1996, according to the central bank's monthly balance sheet released on Tuesday.

NOTE - In a statement the Central Bank said its net foreign sale of foreign currency in November was 3.7 billion crowns. The November foreign reserves compared with average analysts' expectations of 83.8 billion crowns, not taking into account state loan transactions.
